decisions.reason: Because it extends the firm's core second-channel authentication capability and survived the initial pruning of weaker launches, its results likely meet a modest aspiration level and the shared platform resources make retention relatively cheap.

Its move to a standalone page suggests performance above aspiration in a strategically central security architecture area, so management would keep it rather than redirect scarce R&D attention elsewhere.

It fits the signature and authentication portfolio and showed enough promise to get dedicated visibility, but as a hardware-based offer in a more app-centric trajectory it remains a borderline product that is kept under uncertainty.

The suite draws on existing compliance and security capabilities for regulated customers, and despite more limited visibility than the strongest products it likely stays on the market unless upcoming sales fall clearly below aspiration.
